observations: Photo 0 shows a single headlight assembly resting on a cardboard box.
The housing is black with a clear lens and an amber turn signal section.
The internal reflector and bulb cage are visible.
A watermark 'JARDON ONIGA' is overlaid on the image.
The image appears to be a screenshot from a mobile phone status screen.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a headlight, but the specific trim or 'Touring' designation is not visible.
No badge, sticker, or model year code is visible in the photo to confirm fitment.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The bulb may be burnt out or the electrical socket may be broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the bulb with the housing open or a video of the bulb being tested.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal scratches or haze that cannot be seen from the angle.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the lens surface.

risks.risk: The assembly may be missing the mounting clips or brackets.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the headlight showing the mounting points.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the bulb with the housing open.
Photo of the rear of the headlight showing the mounting clips.
Photo of the lens surface to check for scratches.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
